title: Register values in the unrolled circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a sequential Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and $r$ registers, let $T$ be a nonnegative integer, and fix an input assignment $x\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. For each time $k$ with $k\le T$ and each register $j$, the value at the unrolled circuit vertex assigned to register $j$ at time $k$ equals the evaluation, on the values of the unrolled circuit, of the gate with no inputs whose type is AND or OR according to whether register $j$ is initially true or false when $k=0$, and of the one-input AND gate reading register $j$'s next-state source at time $k-1$ when $k>0$.
hypotheses_covered: An input assignment $x$ to the $n$ inputs
A register index $j$ among the $r$ registers
